module: MCP tools for the scenetree: find objects (by class or name), inspect them like the editor inspector, modify their fields, delete them, serialize them, list objects visible in the camera's field of view and cast a raycast.
notes: set_object_field converts all values to strings (setField) then calls postApply; a position is written '1 2 3'. delete_object is permanent for the session.
find_objects returns at most 500 objects; view_objects too (sorted by distance, maxDist default 1000 m).

view_objects: class accepts a keyword (vehicles default, static, item, player, terrain, water) or an exact class name; a raw `mask` takes precedence. Uses sceneGetVisibleObjectIds (C++ frustum query).
raycast: by default from the camera in its direction, length 1000; includeTerrain true by default, renderGeometry false; returns pt, norm and the scalar fields of the castRay result.

find_objects.desc: Finds objects by exact name or by class (with optional substring filter).

returns.desc: true if neither class nor name.

get_object.desc: Inspects an object: id, name, class, non-empty static fields, dynamic fields, position.

set_object_field.desc: Writes one or more fields of an object then calls postApply.

args.desc: {id?|name?, field?: string, value?: any, fields?: table<string, any>, index?: string (default '0')}

delete_object.desc: Deletes an object from the scene (obj:deleteObject()).

serialize_object.desc: Serializes the object as JSON/text as in a level or prefab file (obj:serialize).

view_objects.desc: Lists the objects in the camera's field of view, sorted by distance.

args.desc: {class?: string, mask?: integer, maxDist?: number m}

returns.desc: JSON {count, objects:[{id, name, class, dist, pos, jbeam?}]}.

raycast.desc: Casts a ray and returns the first hit.

args.desc: {from?: {x,y,z}, to?: {x,y,z}, dir?: {x,y,z}, length?: number m, includeTerrain?: boolean, renderGeometry?: boolean}

returns.desc: JSON {hit=false, from, to} or {hit=true, pt, norm, …}.
